Replies to letter of December 31, 1974, from Department of Interior to T.O. Jones (NSF)
Deep Sea Drilling Project procedures re monitoring will be followed as closely as possible. The <u>Deep Sea Drilling Project Safety Manual</u> is available to RISP.
Reference the last paragraph. Given a rate of ice movement of one (1) meter per day, the maximum depth of sediment drilling is a function of drill rate versus water depth, since it is the distance between the bottom of the ice and the sea floor that will determine the rate of pipe bend and ultimately the end of drilling.
